node.statement: For 0 != Z put r_Z=||h_1(Z)||/||Z||. The preceding child gives r_Z^2 >= (1-K_sq e)a_1-C_prod e. The set of r_Z is nonempty and contained in [0,infinity), with infimum a_1. Monotonicity and continuity of t -> t^2 on [0,infinity) give inf_Z r_Z^2=(inf_Z r_Z)^2=a_1^2. Taking infima therefore yields a_1^2 >= (1-K_sq e)a_1-C_prod e, i.e. p(a_1)>=0 for p(t)=t^2-(1-K_sq e)t+C_prod e.
